nodes.label: Cost gate (mandatory pre-spend approval)
nodes.rationale: Prevents any spend before showing (number of runs) x run_cost = total and getting explicit user approval; a compose look must count as 1 run, not multiplied by outputs or files, because outputs-per-run are free and the price is flat.

nodes.label: Checkpointed, resumable state-file pattern
nodes.rationale: FLORA's sandbox cannot read local files or reach the internet, so bytes must move via local curl; batch_state.json/compose_state.json bridge the two worlds and let an interrupted run (expired upload URL, timeout, insufficient credits) resume without double-charging.

nodes.label: Idempotency-key retry pattern (same key vs fresh key)
nodes.rationale: The code server 502s often so network retries must be free (same key = safe re-submit, no double charge), but a generation that actually failed is a new run and needs a fresh key to re-execute — the same key would only return the dead run.
nodes.norm_label: idempotency-key retry pattern (same key vs fresh key)

nodes.label: DRY/YAGNI convention (pure logic in floralib.py, thin scripts)
nodes.rationale: All pure, network-free logic lives in floralib.py; the CLI scripts stay thin wrappers over it, and config knobs nobody asked for are not added.
nodes.norm_label: dry/yagni convention (pure logic in floralib.py, thin scripts)

nodes.label: Copy-based (not symlinked) skill deployment
nodes.rationale: ~/.claude/skills/flora-batch/ is an independent copy of skills/flora-batch/; editing the repo does not update a live installed skill until it is re-copied, because skills are discovered at session start rather than hot-reloaded.

nodes.label: Host-aware pristine downloads (ImageKit vs media.flora.ai)
nodes.rationale: ?tr=orig-true is an ImageKit-only transform for the lossless original; media.flora.ai outputs are already full-res PNG and must be downloaded bare — applying the wrong one wastes a request or fetches an unexpected response. floralib.output_variants encodes this host-specific logic.

nodes.label: Correction: no auto file-bridge for oversized execute output
nodes.rationale: The previously documented rule that oversized execute results auto-save to a local file is false — the MCP server hard-errors 'Output exceeded 100000 bytes' with no file path. Fix: keep returns small (~10 reservations/call), write files locally yourself, and rely on upload.py's HTTP-status check plus optional floralib.validate_gcs_reservation linting as the real safety net for hand-transcribed signed data.
nodes.norm_label: correction: no auto file-bridge for oversized execute output

nodes.label: Feature-branch convention (never commit to main)
nodes.rationale: Work happens on feature branches (e.g. feat/flora-batch-hardening) created with git switch -c; never commit directly to main, keeping hardening work isolated and reviewable.
